name: British Flats, Units and Floors
description: The part of a building before its name or number: a flat, apartment, unit, studio, suite or maisonette with its number (Glasgow's 2/1 and Edinburgh's 1F2 among them), a named part of a building with no number (Basement Flat, Garden Flat), and a floor. Original cases written for this corpus from Royal Mail's addressing rules, described in our own words; nothing copied.
